exposure: Angle of progression (AOP) before labor induction
cohort: 143 nulliparous Japanese women with singleton term pregnancies in cephalic presentation undergoing labor induction.
finding: An AOP less than 91.2 degrees and pre-pregnancy BMI were associated with an elevated risk for emergency cesarean section following labor induction, with the AOP being a strong predictor.
mod_finding: An AOP less than 91.2 degrees was identified as an optimal cutoff for predicting emergency cesarean section following labor induction.
